facts: The prior cache-reuse candidate trusted an extracted portable Python when python.exe merely existed.

The candidate now caches only the Python 3.12.10 embeddable ZIP, verifies the upstream-published SHA-256 before reuse and before extraction, and rebuilds the extracted interpreter directory on every run.
Regression coverage asserts SHA-256 pinning, verification-before-extraction, no extracted-interpreter reuse, bounded retries, and fail-closed command handling.
Generic PR CI was restarted for the new exact head and must finish before any merge consideration.
decision: Keep PR #380 Draft and deny merge until exact-head CI is green and the affected self-hosted Local Runner path is validated. The remaining get-pip bootstrap is network-fetched and not yet independently content-pinned, so complete supply-chain authority is not claimed.
lesson: Reliability caches on self-hosted runners must cache verifiable immutable inputs rather than trust mutable extracted executables by existence.
security_boundary: No credentials, signing, billing, production deployment, live trading, financial action, or weakening of data/security gates is authorized.
